groups.name: agentspaces.bootstrap
groups.description: How each group finds a beacon: the fleet-wide bootstrap chain settings (SRAD appendix D).

groups.name: agentspaces.groups[].bootstrap
groups.description: One group's bootstrap chain settings, over the fleet-wide block.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.domain
properties.description: The domains the DNS-SD and TXT locators search: a list, or 'auto' for the host's search list, or empty for none. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.order
properties.description: The chain order; a locator absent from the list is not asked. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.first-wins
properties.description: Stop at the first locator that answers with endpoints instead of asking all and merging. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.timeout
properties.description: The per-locator timeout. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.refresh-min
properties.description: The shortest pause before the chain is asked again on an empty view. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.refresh-max
properties.description: The longest pause before the chain is asked again on an empty view. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.accept-group-id-from
properties.description: The locators whose GroupId claim is honoured when none is configured. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.insecure-group-id
properties.description: Allow an unauthenticated locator (dns-*, k8s, multicast) in accept-group-id-from. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.beacon-peer
properties.description: The PeerId that must have signed any beacon document; empty for any. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.url
properties.description: Beacon document URLs, comma or space separated. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.url-allow-plain
properties.description: Allow http:// beacon document URLs. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.url-allow-hosts
properties.description: The hosts a beacon document URL may name; empty for any. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.url-allow-private
properties.description: Allow beacon document URLs that resolve to private or loopback addresses. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.expand-names
properties.description: One endpoint per address of a seed name. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.bean-locators-first
properties.description: Place the application's BeaconLocator beans before the property-built locators. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.require
properties.description: Fail startup when no locator answered within the deadline. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.trace
properties.description: Log every locate at INFO with each locator's evidence. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.dns-srv
properties.description: The SRV owner name the dns-srv locator asks (_aspace._tcp.seeds.example). Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.dns-srv-scheme
properties.description: The transport scheme SRV and Kubernetes endpoints take; empty for the node's default. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.dns-sd-any-group
properties.description: Let the DNS-SD locator accept any advertised instance, not only the group's own name. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.document
properties.description: A beacon document to use as is: a file path or a classpath: resource. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.k8s.service
properties.description: The headless Kubernetes service whose pods are the seeds. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.k8s.namespace
properties.description: The service's namespace; empty for the pod's own. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.k8s.port-name
properties.description: The named port of the service the SRV records carry. Fleet-wide default.

properties.name: agentspaces.bootstrap.k8s.cluster-domain
properties.description: The cluster domain. Fleet-wide default.
